Post 1

📉 Friday's damage was selective but sharp. ASX 200 shed 24.90pts (-0.27%) to 9,058.90, sitting 2.56% off its 52-week high. Health care and property bled hard while defensives held. The index lost 0.62% on the week. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 A-REITs led the selloff at -2.40%, Consumer Discretionary -1.82%, Health Care -1.79%. Telcos bucked the trend at +0.32%, Energy +0.32%, Financials +0.23%. Defensive rotation in a risk-off Friday close. #ASX #ausbiz #realestate

Post 3

ZIP collapsed 15.74% to AUD 2.570, the worst print in the ASX 200 today. Telix Pharma fell 10.13% to AUD 15.620. Meanwhile NRW Holdings surged 8.04% to AUD 8.200 — infrastructure spending narrative still alive. #ASX #ausbiz #healthcare

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,396.15/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7140. Silver AUD 97.05/oz. Metals sector edged +0.17% — gold strength cushioned miners from a broader risk-off rout. #ASX #gold #metals #mining

Post 5

Watch the AUD/USD 0.7140 handle into next week. A break higher pressures gold miners' margins; a retreat supports them. With ASX 200 at 9,058.90, where do you see the index heading — retest of highs or more downside? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
